registry.origin: 2026-11-15 R3W2 Onyxia: the paladin tank's Divine Shield at +16 s sent her into the raid
registry.what: a paladin tank held by the boss never Divine Shields (Lay on Hands instead)

registry.origin: 2026-11-15 R3W2 Onyxia phase 2: seven rogues on one whelp, one Engulfing Flames, 15 dead
registry.what: while the boss is airborne, at most two melee per small add

registry.origin: 2026-11-15 R3W2 Onyxia phase 3: healers crossed her front, one Flame Breath killed 8
registry.what: a healer's closing walk never crosses a breather's other arc

registry.origin: 2026-11-15 R3W0 Onyxia: two phase-3 wipes began with a feared, unwarded tank
registry.what: priests Fear Ward every tank before the pull

registry.origin: 2026-11-15 R3W0 Onyxia: the first ward came 35 s after she landed
registry.what: with the boss tank and backup warded, the other tanks get one too

registry.origin: 2026-11-15 R3W0/R3W1: Earthshaker handed to a tank at every council, never worn
registry.what: loot council never hands a tank a two-handed weapon

registry.origin: 2026-11-16 R3W8/R3W9 Onyxia: every phase-3 wall turn swept her Flame Breath across the raid (hits up to 59 deg off her facing on members already moving out); W9 att. 1 33 %, att. 2 wipe
registry.what: once she has landed (below 40 %) her tank holds her where she faces: no wall turning

registry.origin: 2026-11-16 R3W7 Onyxia 33 %: her head was turned to the nearest wall, 28 yd west, where the healers and ranged stood - one Flame Breath at +311 s killed 3, the next 3 more
registry.what: the cone boss's wall is the one with the fewest members between her head and it

registry.origin: 2026-11-16 R3W6 Onyxia 39 %: tanks taunted her in the air (no effect), Taunt was on cooldown when she landed, a hunter held her and one Flame Breath killed 6
registry.what: tanks never taunt the boss while she is airborne: the taunt is kept for her landing

registry.origin: 2026-11-16 R3W5: Staff of Dominance + Earthshaker 'in bags' on an Arms warrior at every council (both scored -100000, worn sword+shield -200000); Helm of Wrath, Belt/Sabatons of Might, Eskhandar's Collar lost to 'Sylwhisper has no bag room'
registry.what: loot council skips pieces the member's scoring rejects and puts the chosen piece on itself

registry.origin: 2026-11-15 R3W3 Onyxia: she landed 66-88 yd from every tank, a warlock held her, one Flame Breath killed 6
registry.what: the boss's two top tanks wait at its landing spot before it lands

registry.origin: 2026-11-14 Onyxia dev rounds (taunt-immune boss, threat wipes, landing); generic until 11-15, held MC bosses and trash back
registry.what: the 11-14 threat rules: tanks-first windows, backup tank, 75/80 % caps, healer holds
